summary:
Production Hosting & Security Readiness:
1. Backend & Routing Hardening: Added /api/health probe, Express 5 wildcard routing, IP rate limiting (180 req/min), body parsing limit (5MB), and X-Content-Type-Options/X-Frame-Options/Permissions-Policy headers.
2. Production Serving: Standardized path.resolve(dist) SPA fallback, API 404 JSON routing, global uncaught error middleware, and graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT process termination.
3. Database Resiliency: Safe PostgreSQL pool connection with comprehensive in-memory Drizzle mock fallback preventing crashes when SQL_HOST is offline.
4. Monetization Endpoints: Verified user-unlocks, PPV unlock status, channel memberships, tipping, and SuperChats.
5. Build & Lint: Zero compile or lint regressions with npm run lint and compile_applet passing.
